title: Siman 360
section: The Virtue of His Torah and His Holy Books

segments.he: אָמַראוֹתִי צְרִיכִים כָּל הָעוֹלָם, לֹא מִבָּעֲיָא אַתֶּם כִּי אַתֶּם יוֹדְעִים בְּעַצְמְכֶם אֵיךְ אַתֶּם
segments.en: (21.) He said: "I only tell you the refuse of my Torah — and it is lower by thousands of thousands and tens of millions of levels than what I actually attain of it. And I cannot say it any lower. And this has already been recorded elsewhere."
